note: Set B correctly binds the Module B (detail C1) segment lengths 3'-8 3/8", 3'-6" and 3'-1 5/16", its total length 10'-3 3/4", and the 3/8" THROUGH BOLT fastener, all of which Set A omits; Set A also invents detailed base-plate conditions and misbinds 1'-11 1/8" as a support post height on top of already stating it as a detail segment. Set A does capture facts B misses: Module A total length 12'-3 3/4", its left segment 2'-3 7/8", and the L3X3X1/4 member profile. Both sets repeat the same values under two or three names and use vague entities (component, beam, PV detail, base block), but B's bindings to the named modules are more faithful overall.
remarks: Base-plate/base-block dimensions (3", 4 3/4" vs 4 13/16", 2", 4") are hard to resolve at this image scale; the two sets bind them to different properties (plate width vs. block spacing; horizontal hole offset vs. hole center height) and at least one binding in each set is probably wrong, so those were only lightly weighted. Note 4 3/4" (A1) and 4 13/16" (C1) differ between details while the other base dims repeat, which suggests that dimension is a varying spacing/offset rather than a fixed plate size. Both sets also leave out other page values (1 1/2", 5/8", 7 1/16", 2'-2 7/8", 6 13/16", 1'-8 11/16", 4 13/16"), though as samples that is not penalized.
